description: RFC 9728 OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata — conformance test vectors.

required_fields.description: The protected resource's resource server URI. MUST be an HTTPS URI in production.
Array of absolute URIs of the authorization servers protecting this resource.

recommended_fields.description: URL of the resource server's JSON Web Key Set (RFC 7517) for token verification.
Array of scope strings the resource server understands.
Bearer token delivery methods supported. Valid values: header, form, query.
JWS signing algorithms supported by the resource server for token validation.
